info.name: Clavata Public API v1 Batch Processing API

params.name: batchJobIds
params.description: IDs of the batch jobs to get. If not provided, all batch jobs will be returned.

params.name: states
params.description: The state of the batch jobs to get. If not provided, all batch jobs will be returned.

items.docs: Retrieves batch jobs, optionally filtered by batch job IDs or states. If no filters are provided, all batch jobs will be returned.

Creates a new batch job that can process multiple content items in bulk. Returns a presigned URL for uploading the input file. The job will automatically start processing once the input file is uploaded.

params.name: batchJobId
params.description: The ID of the batch job to cancel

items.docs: Cancels a batch job. This will stop the batch job from being processed further.
